begin_of_turn_query.content: Alright, I've been thinking about a road trip and I want to use my own car for the journey. That's quite a stretch—450 miles in one go today. Is this something I could realistically pull off? I just want to know a answer; you don't need to refill if it's not reachable. If it is reachable, set navigation to '1914 7th St, Apt B, Berkeley, CA 94710'.
